summary: Frontend-only re-verification of iteration_7 light-mode contrast fixes. Logged in as admin@garage.com, forced light theme via localStorage and ran a programmatic WCAG contrast audit (effective background blending for alpha fills) across /dashboard, /repairs, /calendar, /invoices, /reminders, /cash-register, /accounts, /inventory, /reports; then re-ran dark mode and re-verified the theme cycle. All 6 reported fixes are confirmed working: Calendar/Repairs/PO status chips now render text-{color}-700 in light (e.g. amber chip rgb(180,83,9) at 4.31:1 vs previously invisible), Dashboard recharts now uses hsl(var(--border)) / hsl(var(--muted-foreground)) (grid lines subtle, axis labels readable), Dashboard KPI accents readable, Repairs job-card header bands (list line 276 and dialog line 549) now bg-secondary = rgb(234,240,246) in light and no longer stark black, and dark mode shows no regressions (chips resolve to *-400 e.g. rgb(251,191,36), body bg rgb(5,8,15)). Theme cycle confirmed light -> dark -> system -> light and persists in localStorage 'garage_theme'. One color was MISSED by the bulk replace: Accounts.jsx text-sky-400.

ui_bugs.issue: MISSED by bulk replace: accent is still hardcoded 'text-sky-400'. In LIGHT mode the 30px bank-account balance ('-180,00 EUR') renders rgb(56,189,248) on white = 2.14:1 contrast (fails even the 3:1 large-text threshold) and is barely legible. Fix: text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400 (matches the pattern used for cash/card on lines 20/22).

Duplicated/conflicting classes: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400'. Renders correctly (last dark: wins) but the stray 'dark:text-rose-600' is dead code and should be removed for consistency with the other statuses.

design_issues.screen: Light mode - minor sub-4.5:1 items (all were already present, none newly introduced)
issues: Sidebar 'OWNER' section label uses text-muted-foreground/70 at 10px -> 3.15:1 on white. Drop the /70 opacity.
Active sidebar item label (text-primary rgb(11,100,244) on bg-primary/15) -> 4.09:1, just under AA for 14px text.
Repairs job-card header band job number (text-primary 9px on bg-secondary) -> 4.42:1; small mono caps, borderline.
Calendar amber in_service chip 4.31:1 at 10px - readable now but still marginally below AA; amber-800 would clear it.
Dashboard top-mover rank badges (text-primary on bg-primary/15) -> 3.89:1.

The gold PitStock logo/wordmark image inside the now-light bg-secondary header band is very faint (asset was tuned for the old black band). Consider a dark/neutral logo variant or a theme-aware filter.

action_items: Accounts.jsx line 21: change accent 'text-sky-400' -> 'text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400' (only remaining hardcoded dark-only color in the app; verified via grep that no other *-300/*-400 text colors remain outside components/ui/toast.jsx).
Optional polish: remove duplicate 'dark:text-rose-600' in Calendar.jsx STATUS_STYLE.cancelled.
Optional polish: sidebar 'OWNER' label opacity (text-muted-foreground/70 -> text-muted-foreground) and light-mode logo variant on the Repairs job-card band.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext.jsx initial resolved state is now correctly derived from localStorage/systemPrefersDark - verified no first-paint flash and correct html class on hard reload.

Dashboard recharts now fully token-driven (grid/axis/tooltip use hsl(var(--*))), which is the right pattern; apply the same for the hardcoded line strokes (#34d399 / #fb7185) if light-mode line visibility ever becomes a concern.
Bulk color-pair replacement is complete except Accounts.jsx:21 - a lint rule banning bare text-*-400/300 without a light counterpart would prevent this class of regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Light-mode contrast fixes from iteration_7 are verified fixed (chips, charts, KPI accents, job-card bands) and dark mode has no regressions. Only remaining functional contrast defect is Accounts.jsx text-sky-400 (2.14:1 in light). A reusable approach: set localStorage 'garage_theme' to 'light'/'dark', reload, then run a page.evaluate contrast audit that blends alpha backgrounds up the ancestor chain - bare getComputedStyle background gives false negatives on the bg-*/15 chips.
rca_of_the_issue: The iteration_7 bulk sed/replace targeted amber/emerald/rose/blue/fuchsia -400 classes only; Accounts.jsx used a sky-400 accent which was outside the replace list, so the bank-account balance kept its dark-mode-only color and now fails contrast on the light card background.
